# Synthetic NSWWS fixtures

All names, geometry and warning wording are invented for tests; these are not operational warnings. Shapes/fields follow the [Met Office NSWWS v1.1 OpenAPI definition](https://datahub.metoffice.gov.uk/downloads/api-definitions/nswws_api_subscriber.json), reviewed 6 October 2026. The issued → updated → cancelled sequence exercises source IDs, native severity, feed snapshots and immutable local history. Unknown properties demonstrate provenance retention. Tests derive malformed, empty and expired variants; no live requests or credentials are used.
